blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa.
blocks.zh: 在大语言模型(LLMs)中,注意对每一个有完整点产品键的查询进行评分. 我们调查这一点产品是否必须完全计算才能引起人们的注意。 我们提议隐蔽的 Sparse 注意(HISA),它保持查询和关键投影的完整,但只计算一个部分点产品,遵循符号位置设定的静态无参数规则: 隐藏的(地貌)维度的注意力变得稀少,这个轴比象征性的螺旋性要少得多,而不是像几乎所有稀疏的注意方法那样超过标记。 基于旋转位置嵌入(ROPE)的结构,我们把密钥和查询分解成在计算注意力时可以省略的部分. 通过从零开始与HISA一起训练LLMS,我们发现这个部分点产品并不伤害,而是比完整的产品提高了性能,同时计算出大约三分之一的查询键产品. 在推论期间,HISA改进了解码速度,缩小了记忆足迹. 我们还将HISA扩展至FlashAttention-3内核用于培训和推论. 最后,我们通过表明密集的注意力学会抑制HISA所减少的注意力部分来激励我们的方法。 代码见https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The attention layer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) of a large language model compares every query with every key via a dot product over the full head dimension. Most work on making attention cheaper keeps this dot product intact and instead reduces the set of keys a query looks at. Strategies to do so include fixed patterns ( Child et al., 2019 ) , sliding windows ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , KV-cache eviction ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) , and query-dependent token selection, training-free ( Tang et al., 2024 ) or learned ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . In this work, we investigate an orthogonal question: whether attention requires computing the complete query–key dot product.
blocks.zh: 一个大型语言模型的注意力层(Vaswani et al., 2017)通过点产品将每个查询与每个键比对整个头维. 多数关于使注意力更便宜的工作使这个点产品保持完好无损,而是减少一组查询所查看的密钥. 这样做的战略包括固定模式(Child等人,2019年),滑窗(Jiang等人,2023年),KV-cache拆迁(Xiao等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2023年),以及依赖查询的标志选择,免培训(Tang等人,2024年)或学习(Yuan等人,2025年)。 在这个作品中,我们调查了一个正交问题:注意力是否需要计算完整的查询-键点产品.

blocks.en: Rotary position embeddings (RoPE) ( Su et al., 2024 ) , used by many modern LLMs ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Team Olmo, 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ; Gemma Team, 2026 ) , give this question a natural structure. RoPE rotates each two-dimensional frequency pair of the query and the key by an angle proportional to its position. Because rotations compose, the two rotations combine into a single one that encodes the relative distance between the query and the key. High-frequency pairs complete many turns within a few tokens, whereas low-frequency pairs barely rotate over the whole context.
blocks.zh: 许多现代LLMs(Grattafiori等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年;Team Olmo,2025年;DeepSeek-AI,2026年;Gemma Team,2026年)使用的Rotary 位置嵌入(ROPE)(Su等人,2024年),赋予这个问题自然结构. RoPE通过与其位置成正比的角旋转查询和密钥的每个二维频率对. 由于旋转构成,两个旋转结合成一个单一的,编码了查询和键之间的相对距离. 高频对在几个符号内完成许多转折,而低频对几乎不会在整个上下文中旋转.

blocks.en: The score parts of fast pairs are therefore highly sensitive to the exact distance between the query and the key, whereas language does not follow an exact structure over distant words or tokens, and sequences can be long. This raises the question of whether every pair needs to be computed at every relative distance. We show that high-frequency pairs are not necessary for the model when distance between tokens is large, and that removing them is harmless or even beneficial.
blocks.zh: 因此,快对子的分数部分对查询和键之间的确切距离高度敏感,而语言在远处的单词或符号上不遵循精确的结构,序列可能很长. 这就提出了一个问题,即是否需要在每个相对距离上计算每一对。 我们显示,当信使之间的距离很大时,高频对对对于模型来说是不必要的,去除它们是无害的甚至有益的.

blocks.en: Our Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA) method turns this hypothesis into an attention rule: the dot product of each frequency pair l l between a query and a key is kept only when the rotation induced by RoPE is below an angle budget Φ \Phi , a hyperparameter that we set to 90 ∘ by default. The query and key projections are unchanged and what becomes sparse is the hidden dimension of the dot product. The sparsity pattern follows from the RoPE frequencies and the positions alone: it has no learned parameter and needs no selection step, unlike sparse attention methods that score, route or select keys at runtime. For a given query, fast pairs only see nearby keys, slow pairs see far.
blocks.zh: 我们的隐藏 Sparse 注意( HISA) 方法将这个假说变成一个注意规则: 只有在RoPE 引导的旋转低于角度预算 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\%\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 查询和关键预测没有变化,变得稀少的是点产品隐藏的维度. sparsity模式仅来自RoPE频率和位置:它没有学习到的参数,不需要选择步骤,不同于在运行时间分数,路由或选择密钥的稀疏的注意方法. 对于给定的查询,快对只见附近的密钥,慢对远见.

blocks.en: We propose HiSA, a new sparse attention architecture that is sparse in the hidden dimension rather than over tokens. Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们提出HISA,一个新的稀疏关注架构,在隐秘的维度中是稀少的,而不是凌驾于象征之上. 我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • Based on the structure of RoPE, we develop HiSA, a sparse attention in the hidden dimension that computes a partial query–key dot product. Its sparsity pattern is static and parameter-free . We derive its compute, reach, and KV-cache footprint ( Section 3 ). • We evaluate HiSA in pretraining from scratch and in long-context extension , implement it in FlashAttention for training and inference, and compare it with dense attention on validation loss, training speed, KV-cache memory, and decoding throughput ( Sections 4.1 , 4.2 , 4.3 and 4.4 ). • For existing models, we show that a pretrained dense model can be converted to HiSA by continued training and matches dense continued training ( Section 4.5 ). • From an interpretability perspective, we show that the score parts that HiSA drops correspond to those that dense attention learns to suppress during training ( Section 5 ): the rule is not only motivated by the geometry of RoPE, but measured in what dense models learn.
blocks.zh: · 基于ROPE的结构,我们开发了HISA,这是隐藏维度中很少的注意,它计算出一个部分的查询-键点产品. 它的螺纹图案是静态的,没有参数。 我们得出其计算、范围和KV-cache足迹(第3节)。 我们从头到尾地评估高级安全局的预训和长文扩展,在FlashAttention中执行,用于培训和推断,并将其与对验证损失、培训速度、KV-cache内存以及解码吞吐量的密集关注相比较(第4.1、4.2、4.3和4.4节)。 就现有模式而言,我们表明,通过继续培训和配合密集的继续培训,可以将预先训练的密集模式转换为高级安全局(第4.5节)。 从可解释性角度,我们显示HISA所降低的分数部分与那些在训练中学习密集注意力来抑制的分数部分相对应(第5节): 规则的动机不仅是RoPE的几何学,而是用密集模型所学的量度.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Attention ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) with RoPE ( Su et al., 2024 ) encodes relative positions by rotating query and key pairs at spaced frequencies θ l = b − 2 l / d \theta_{l}=b^{-2l/d} . Barbero et al. (2025) show that Gemma 7B uses the highest frequencies for positional attention patterns and suggest that the lowest carry semantic information; Men et al. (2024) and Liu et al. (2024) relate the RoPE base to the usable context length, and Wang et al. (2026a) learn per-head frequencies. Exact attention is made fast by the IO-aware FlashAttention kernels ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2024 ; Shah et al., 2024 ) , which we extend.
blocks.zh: 注意(Vaswani等人,2017年)与ROPE(Su等人,2024年)通过旋转查询和在空间频率的键对来编码相对位置 θl = b - 2 l / d\theta_{l}=b^{-2l/d}. Barbero等人(2025年)表明,Gemma 7B对位置注意模式使用频率最高,并暗示携带语义信息最少;Men等人(2024年)和Liu等人. (2024)将ROPE基础与可用上下文长度联系起来,Wang等人(2026a)学习每头频率. iO-aware闪存内核(Dao et al., 2022;Dao 2024;Shah et al., 2024)快速关注,我们扩展了这些内核.

blocks.en: Static patterns and sliding windows ( Child et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) restrict each query to a subset of keys. For inference, KV-cache eviction keeps attention sinks and recent tokens ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) or heavy hitters ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , and Quest ( Tang et al., 2024 ) selects cache pages per query. Recent methods are trained with the sparsity in place, using block-sparse kernels: NSA ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) combines compressed, selected and sliding-window branches, and MoBA ( Lu et al., 2025 ) routes each query to the top-scoring blocks of keys.
blocks.zh: 静态图案和滑动窗口(Child等人,2019年;Beltagy等人,2020年;Zaheer等人,2020年;Jiang等人,2023年)将每个查询限制在一个密钥子集中. 推论,KV-cache的驱逐会保持注意力的沉积和最近的代号(Xiao等人,2024年)或重击手(Zhang等人,2023年),Quest(Tang等人,2024年)会选择每个查询的缓存页. 使用块片内核, NSA(Yuan等人,2025年)将压缩,选择和滑动的窗口分支合并,MOBA(Lu等人,2025年)将每个查询到键的顶级积分块.

blocks.en: Several inference methods exploit the feature dimension, but mostly as a proxy for selecting tokens. SparQ ( Ribar et al., 2024 ) and Loki ( Singhania et al., 2024 ) approximate the scores with a few query components or a low-rank key projection, select the top keys, and then compute the full dot product over them; Double Sparsity ( Yang et al., 2024 ) calibrates important channels offline and FASA ( Wang et al., 2026b ) uses a few dominant RoPE frequency chunks for the same purpose. The final attention of these methods is sparse over tokens, not in the hidden dimension. ThinK ( Xu et al., 2025 ) does compute the final score on fewer features, by pruning key-cache channels, but chooses them from the content and applies the same pruning to all but the most recent tokens. All of these methods are applied after training. Sparse Feature Attention ( Xie et al., 2026 ) trains models whose queries and keys keep only their k k largest-magnitude features, chosen per vector from the content; HiSA instead fixes the kept parts by the positions alone, through the RoPE rotation angles.
blocks.zh: 有几种推论方法利用特征维度,但大多是作为选择符的代词. SparQ 状态 (Ribar et al., 2024)和Loki(Singhania et al., 2024) 大致分数为几个查询组件或低档密钥投影,选择顶部密钥,然后在它们之上计算全点产物; 双点分量(Yang et al., 2024)校准离线的重要通道,FASA(Wang et al., 2026b)为同一目的使用几个占优势的RoPE频率块. 这些方法最后的注意力不多于象征,而不是隐藏的维度. ThinK(徐等人,2025年)确实在更少的特性上计算最终得分,通过刷卡键-cache通道,但从内容中选择,并且除了最新的符号外,对所有人应用相同的刷卡. 所有这些方法都是在培训后采用的。 Sparse Feature Note (Xie et al., 2026) 列车的车型,其查询和键只保留其kk最大放大特性,从内容中选择每个矢量;HISA转而通过ROPE旋转角度,单靠位置固定保存的部分.

blocks.en: Two concurrent works also restrict each RoPE pair to a window proportional to its wavelength. ATFlash ( Hayashi et al., 2026 ) applies such windows to pretrained models without training (two periods by default) and ports them to FlashAttention-4 prefill and FlashInfer decode, with speedups that grow with context length. WavePrune ( Du et al., 2026 ) restricts each pair to one rotation period, both training-free and when pretraining GPT-2 models from scratch, with FlashAttention-based forward and backward kernels. WavePrune explains the window by the aliasing that fast pairs cause in the attention maps of pretrained models. Both works skip computation and key reads, but neither reduces the KV cache: every key and value stays in memory. HiSA differs in three ways. It trains with much tighter budgets (a quarter period at 90 ∘ ), where the partial product clearly improves the loss at the training length. It turns the rule into an actual KV-cache reduction, for keys per chunk and for values beyond the reach. Moreover, an interpretability analysis of dense models explains why the dropped pairs are not needed: dense training itself learns to suppress them.
blocks.zh: 两个并行的作品也限制每组ROPE配对一个与其波长成比例的窗口. ATFlash(Hayashi et al., 2026)将此类窗口应用于未经训练的预训模型(默认为两期),并将它们移植到FlashAtthind-4预装和FlashInfer解码,其速度随上下文长度增长. WavePrune(Du等人,2026年)将每对选手限制在一个旋转期,既无训练,也无预训GPT-2型号从零开始时使用FlashAtthind基于前核和后核. WavePrune通过快速对子在预训模型的注意力图中导致的异名来解释窗口. 两部作品都跳过计算并读取密钥,但都没有减少KV缓存:每个密钥和值都留在内存中. HISA在三个方面有所不同. 其培训预算要紧得多(四分之一期间为90年),其中部分产品明显改善了培训时间的损失。 它把规则变成了一个实际的 KV- cache 递减, 对于每个块的密钥和对于无法达到的值. 此外,对稠密模型的可解释性分析解释了为何不需要投对:密集训练本身就学会压制它们.

blocks.en: RoPE models are extended by interpolating positions ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2024 ) or raising the base ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) , followed by continued pretraining on long documents mixed with short data ( Xiong et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) . We follow this recipe to study HiSA beyond its pretraining length.
blocks.zh: RoPE模型通过插值位置(Chen等人,2023年;Peng等人,2024年)或提高基数(Xiong等人,2024年)加以扩展,然后继续就与短数据混合的长文件进行预训(Xiong等人,2024年;Gao等人,2025年). 我们遵循这个食谱来研究HISA 超越其预训时间.

For a fast pair, moving the key by a single token, a negligible change relative to the distance Δ \Delta , already rotates the pair by θ l \theta_{l} (up to one radian), so its score part s i ​ j ( l ) s^{(l)}_{ij} ( Equation 2 ) changes drastically. In other words, even a minor change in sentence structure or word order in the distant context of the key may have an important impact on the score. Language models, however, use distant context differently from nearby context: recurrent language models rely on word order only within the last few dozen tokens and treat more distant history as a coarse, order-insensitive context ( Khandelwal et al., 2018 ) . The relevant context far from the query is thus rarely tied to an exact offset.

blocks.en: Token-sparse attention removes entries of the T × T T\times T score matrix, while HiSA keeps the entries and removes, for each of them, some of the P P score parts that make up the score. The pattern is static: it depends only on the distance i − j i-j and on the RoPE frequencies, not on the content of the queries and keys. HiSA therefore adds no parameter, no router and no top- k k selection; the only new quantity is the hyperparameter Φ \Phi , and the projections, the values and the softmax are unchanged. Two consequences matter in practice. First, the model is trained with exactly the pattern it uses at inference. Second, which parts are needed is known before any token is seen, so kernels skip them without a selection pass and the KV cache drops each part of a key once it leaves the window ( Section 4.4 ). With Φ = ∞ \Phi=\infty , HiSA is dense attention.

blocks.en: We train decoder-only models with the SmolLM-135M and SmolLM-360M architectures ( Ben Allal et al., 2024 ) (head dimension d = 64 d=64 , i.e. 32 RoPE pairs, grouped-query attention Ainslie et al., 2023 ) from scratch on OpenWebText ( Gokaslan and Cohen, 2019 ) , for about 20 tokens per parameter, with AdamW, a cosine schedule and a peak learning rate selected for the dense model. blocks.en: 4.2 Flash-HiSA: HiSA in FlashAttention
blocks.zh: 4.2 Flash-HISA:闪存的HISA

blocks.en: When using the exact rule, each pair’s window ends at a different distance, so a pair is kept for some entries of a FlashAttention tile and not for others which is not efficient for GPU’s vectorized operations. Flash-HiSA follows the exact rule but applies it block by block instead. Queries and keys are cut along the sequence into blocks of S = 128 S=128 tokens, and the features into chunks of 16 (8 pairs, one matrix-multiply step on Hopper GPUs), so K K is a grid of 128 × 16 128\times 16 tiles. For a query block and a key block, the kept pairs are those that the exact rule keeps at the closest distance between the two blocks. Each tile of K K is then multiplied in full or skipped, and the one chunk cut by the rule is multiplied with its dropped pairs set to zero in Q Q ( Figure 3 ). This block rule keeps every score part of the exact rule plus up to S − 1 S-1 tokens more per pair: an approximation of HiSA that fits the tiling of FlashAttention, and a different model (training and inference must use the same S S ). We implement it in FlashAttention-3 ( Shah et al., 2024 ) , forward and backward ( Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 在使用精确规则时,每对窗口会以不同的距离结束,因此为FlashAttention瓷砖的某些条目保留一对,而不是为GPU的向量操作效率不高的其他条目保留一对. Flash-HISA遵循准确的规则,但逐块应用. 查询和键沿顺序被切成S=128 S=128令牌的块,特征被切成16块(8对,Hopper GPU上一个矩阵-乘积步骤),因此KK是一个128×16128\time16瓦的网格. 对于一个查询块和密钥块,所保存的对数是精确规则在两个块之间保持最近距离的对数. 然后,K K 的每块瓦片被完全乘以或跳过,按规则切割的一块块被乘以在QQ中被设定为零(图3). 这个块规则保留了准确规则的每个分数部分加上S - 1 S-1的每对多一个令牌:一个符合FlashAttyt的平板的HISA的近似,和一个不同的模型(训练和推论必须使用相同的S S ). 我们在FlashAttention-3(Shah等人,2024年),前向和后向(附录D)中执行.

blocks.en: 4.4 KV cache and decoding
blocks.zh: 4.4 KV缓存和解码

blocks.en: A cached key needs pair l l only for Δ max , l \Delta_{\max,l} tokens and its value only within the reach. Flash-HiSA stores each 16-feature key chunk in its own ring buffer, as long as the window of its slowest pair, and its decoding kernel reads only the chunks still in use ( Appendix D ). blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We asked whether attention needs the complete query–key dot product. With RoPE, the score splits into one part per frequency pair, and HiSA keeps each part only while its rotation stays within an angle budget. This sparsity needs no learned selection: it is fixed by the positions, so it is known before any token is seen. In our preliminary experiments with 135M- and 360M-parameter models, this partial product gives a lower validation loss than the complete one while computing only part of it. We also developed Flash-HiSA, a FlashAttention-3 implementation of HiSA, which trains at a similar speed to dense FlashAttention-3 while increasing decoding speed and reducing memory footprint during inference. The advantage persists when using long-context extension and a model trained with dense attention can be converted to HiSA by continued training without losing quality. An analysis of the head outputs suggests why: during training, a dense model learns to suppress the score pairs with large rotations, which HiSA removes by construction. Open questions such as scaling to bigger models, downstream tasks benchmarking and better kernel design are left for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们问是否需要完整的查询- 键点产品 。 有了ROPE,得分分成每对频率的一个部分,HISA只保留每个部分,而其旋转则停留在一个角度预算范围内. 这种麻痹不需要学习选择:它是由位置固定的,所以在看到任何符号之前就知道了. 在我们用135M-和360M-参数模型进行的初步实验中,这种部分产物的验证损失比完整的还低,同时只计算其中的一部分. 我们还开发了Flash-HISA,是HISA的FlashAttenty-3执行,它以与密集的FlashAtenty-3相似的速度进行列车,同时提高解码速度,减少推论期间的内存足迹. 在使用长文本扩展时,这种优势依然存在,通过继续培训而不会失去质量,可以将一个受过密集关注的模型转换成HISA. 对头部输出的分析表明原因:在训练中,密集的模型学习用大旋转压制分数对,HISA通过构造来消除. 推广到更大的模型,下游任务基准化,更好的内核设计等开放性问题留待未来工作解决.

blocks.en: Appendix D Kernels

blocks.en:
The exact rule is computed by FlashAttention-2-style fused kernels for the forward and the backward pass, written in
Triton. The query and key features are permuted so that each 16-feature chunk holds 8 RoPE pairs (the two features of
each pair together). For a tile of query and key positions, the pairs whose window covers the whole tile, the pairs
that are dropped on the whole tile, and the “mixed” pairs whose window ends inside the tile are separated, and the
mixed pairs are masked element-wise; with integer thresholds L l = ⌈ Δ max , l ⌉ L_{l}=\lceil\Delta_{\max,l}\rceil the result equals the reference
rule exactly. At 4K context they train 1.7 times slower than dense attention with SDPA ( Table 2 ).

With the block rule ( Figure 3 ) and a rule block equal to the key tile ( S = 128 S=128 ), the set of kept pairs is the
same for every entry of a tile and depends only on the block distance ( Figure 6 a). Since windows grow with
the pair index, the dropped pairs are always the fastest ones: a tile at block distance n n drops the first a n a_{n} pairs, i.e. the chunks below K 0 = ⌊ a n / 8 ⌋ K_{0}=\lfloor a_{n}/8\rfloor and a n mod 8 a_{n}\bmod 8 pairs of chunk K 0 K_{0} . We add this rule
to the FlashAttention-3 forward and backward kernels as a separate kernel instance. The query–key product of a tile
runs the tensor-core matrix multiply only over the chunks K 0 , … , 3 K_{0},\dots,3 , and the dropped pairs of chunk K 0 K_{0} are
zeroed in the shared-memory copy of the query tile ( Figure 6 b). The key blocks are visited from near to far,
so K 0 K_{0} only grows along the loop: the loop is split into one straight segment per value of K 0 K_{0} , without a runtime
branch inside the asynchronous matrix-multiply pipeline, and the zeroing is cumulative. A small table (pairs dropped
per block distance, the four distances where a whole chunk drops, and the thresholds) is the only input that depends
on the angle budget and the RoPE base. Blocks beyond the reach are skipped entirely through the kernel’s sliding-window
bounds. In the backward pass the recomputation of the scores skips the dropped chunks in the same way; the other
products (with d ​ O dO , V V and the score gradients) still run at full width, which is why the backward pass does not yet
benefit from the sparsity ( Section 4.3 ). Applying RoPE directly in the chunked feature layout avoids permuting
the queries and keys.

cache is split across thread blocks whose partial results are merged at the end. The keys are stored as four ring
buffers, one per 16-feature chunk, each as long as the window of its slowest pair rounded up to whole 128-token blocks,
and the values in a ring as long as the reach ( Figure 6 c). The token at position j j lives in slot j mod M c j\bmod M_{c} of ring c c , of length M c M_{c} ; since every ring holds whole blocks, a key tile never wraps around. The producer threads load
the cache with asynchronous copies; each thread always loads the same chunk, and skips the load when its chunk is
dropped for the current key block, so the dropped chunks are never read from memory.
